objective: Review and repair responsive alignment, clipping and unintended overflow while retaining the approved Arena Criolla arcade design.

fixes.behavior: Supported 24-character names with no spaces wrap inside cards instead of being hidden by the card edge.
Room text can shrink and wrap while the thumbnail and join button retain their space, including 20-character host names at 320px.
Pause card fits mobile and short landscape arenas. A definite width prevents aspect ratio from widening the page when the paused arena becomes taller. Resuming returns to normal battle dimensions.

Results use content height and a single column through tablet widths and short landscape. Short landscape gets more horizontal space and compact spacing/type. All content remains reachable via deliberate scrolling if necessary; fullscreen overlay stays anchored to the viewport.

behaviors: Native photo upload showed three previews; removing one restored the add-photo button.
Native rematch started a new introduction.
Native continue resumed the match and restored arena dimensions.
Actual keyboard controls finished a two-player match with a 20-character winner nickname and unlock message.
Full page reload removed tab-local creator fixtures.
parentVerification.creatorFixtures: Tab-local creatorApi responses only; ready/published/failed/drawing cards used existing sprite assets for geometry. No generation or database writes.

additionalRosterChecks.method: Native search (no results and one result), last roster page, and legends category at all 13 review sizes. Intentional screen-reader-only hiding and portrait cropping are excluded from unintended clipping.

build.existingWarning: Vite reports a JavaScript bundle larger than 500kB; this change does not modify JavaScript.

limitations: Viewport checks use the native T3 Chromium preview; physical devices, mobile software keyboard and mobile pointer emulation were not tested.

The preview sometimes resets the DOM viewport to 400x300 on entering fullscreen while capturing an image at the requested 844x390 size. Actual 400x300 fullscreen layout and scrolling were checked; the requested 844x390 fullscreen size is not claimed as verified. A separate run did report correct 932x430 bounds.
No live creator generation was requested. The authenticated cards were explicit review fixtures.

cleanup.fixtureRemoval: Reloaded the real application; creator session is unauthenticated.
